programme.title: First to Fight
programme.desc: The arrival of the 1st Provisional Marine Brigade in August 1950 bolstered the U.S. forces in the Pusan perimeter. The attacking North Korean army was stalled in the attempt to overrun the perimeter.

programme.title: The Reich Underground
programme.desc: After securing special permission, a team of highly qualified experts explore the sprawling tunnel systems, finding their way into manmade caverns unseen for decades. The film also documents the horrors faced by forced laborers, compelled to construct the tunnel system under the most inhuman conditions.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: Battle of Midway to Victory in the Pacific
programme.desc: The Battle for Midway, as remembered by a Japanese Submarine Commander and a US Sailor.

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: The most fundamental need of any society is a reliable food supply. During WW2, every combatant nation introduced some form of rationing - but that was only the start of the business of keeping the population fed.

programme.title: Visions of War: World War II - The Beginning
programme.desc: Captured German film of the attack on Holland, May 1940. Paratroopers assemble the planes and head for Moerdijk, Holland, and drop the troops. A field fortification is stormed and a Dutch bunker defending the Moerdijk Bridge is attacked and captured. Mines are removed from the bridge. The bridge is shelled by Dutch artillery. German planes are directed to targets by signal panels.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: In 1944, cameraman Felix Forestier was secretly sent to film the French Resistance in Vercors. His unique footage was lost and forgotten until 2013. How did it disappear for so long? Why did the maquis de Vercors become a symbol of the French Resistance, yet is often remembered as a failure? This series uncovers the story of the Vercors maquis and its lasting impact on history.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: In different ways, in different places, new leaders take centre stage: Hitler in Germany, Roosevelt in the US. Militarism triumphs in Japan, which consolidates its invasion of China's north east. By the time the offices of president and chancellor have been combined into a single Fuhrer, Hitler has achieved absolute power in a one-party state without acting unconstitutionally.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: Twenty years after Kaiser Wilhem's exile in 1919, the German navy, Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time by Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain in her naval history. They possessed a terrifying weapon to make sure Hitler's victory and vision was realized, especially over Great Britain. The U-Boat.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The U-Boat War

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: Stalin's death in 1953 unleashes revolt: Berlin workers strike, Hungary rises in 1956, and Khrushchev's denunciation stirs hope. But Soviet tanks crush uprisings, leaving repression harsher than ever. People live double lives-outwardly loyal, privately critical. In 1961, the Berlin Wall seals the Iron Curtain, trapping Eastern Europe in Moscow's grip.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: While Hitler faced frustrations on all fronts, and the Japanese were kept at bay by the Americans, despite heavy US casualties, the Allied leaders faced a new challenge. Although Churchill and Roosevelt had always been comfortable working together, the Russian leader Joseph Stalin had in the past been regarded more as a foe than a friend.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As winter gave way to spring the world watched and waited as the Allied forces prepared for Operation Overlord. Brave and daring, risking all, US General Dwight D Eisenhower took charge of the campaign to deliver the fight directly to Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The Allied landings on D Day and the subsequent battles for control of Normandy.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: With Berlin divided by the Allies, a new world emerges from the ashes. At the Nuremberg Trials, top Nazi leaders face judgment for war crimes, including Hermann Göring, Rudolf Hess, Joachim von Ribbentrop, and Albert Speer. The trials expose the full scale of Nazi atrocities and set a precedent for international justice. As the world reflects, justice seeks to bring closure to the horrors of WWII.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Helicopters
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry looks at helicopters, such as the Bell UH-1 Iroquois 'Huey', Bristol 173, Sikorsky SH-3 Sea King, Sikorsky H-34 Choctaw, and many more.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Through the stories of a jurist, an executioner, and a regime opponent, this investigation reveals how Nazi law justified extermination. Expert voices and archives show how Germany's intellectual elite enabled a murderous totalitarian state.
programme.sub-title: A Justice of Terror - Part II: Twisted Justice on Trial

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The second world war ended more than 70 years ago, but wars never end. For those who fought the memories are indestructible. To understand something so profound we must start before the beginning with what Churchill called, The Gathering Storm.

programme.title: The Flying Tigers
programme.desc: In 1941, a motley dressed group of Americans sailed across the Pacific. Few who saw this ragtag group would've guessed that they would soon become one of the most famous military units in history. The American Volunteer Group entered the war through the backdoor, literally. By the time they arrived in Asia, Japan controlled all of China's ports. So they traveled to Rangoon, Burma.
programme.sub-title: Battle Over China - The Tigers Swipe

programme.title: Nancy Wake: Gestapo's Most Wanted
programme.desc: This is the incredible true story of Nancy Wake. Codenamed 'The White Mouse' for her elusiveness, she was a key inspiration behind Sebastian Faulkes' celebrated fictional spy Charlotte Gray. In this first ever docudrama biopic on Wake, gripping dramatisations are combined with exclusive interviews with her closest friends, confidants and military historians to bring her legend to life.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: When infantry comes up against tanks, the odds are on the tanks. The 908th Field Artillery Battalion was tasked to clear a road littered with German tanks; their chances were slim. The surrounding forest camouflaged the enemy's tanks. The 908th needed an 'invisible soldier' to provide targeting coordinates to the enemy's big guns. Sgt. Pemberton, previously called 'chicken', was that man.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. The pro-Russian separatists bring up a tank to the airport and then launch an aggressive attack. Having suffered losses, the Ukrainian military and volunteers repel the offensive and raise the Ukrainian flag over the Donetsk airport again.

programme.title: The Flying Tigers
programme.desc: In April 1943, two American generals traveled from China to Washington. They had the same goal, to drive Japan out of China, but very different agendas. General Claire Chennault wanted more plans. General Joseph Stilwell wanted equipment for the infantry. Only one man could decide what to do, US President Franklin Roosevelt.

programme.title: Battle of the Somme (No Dialogue)
programme.desc: A 100 year old film depicts trench warfare, showing marching infantry, artillery firing on German positions, British troops waiting to attack on 1 July and treatment of British and German wounded. Also includes British and German dead and captured German equipment and positions. A scene during which British troops crouch in a ditch then 'go over the top' was staged for the camera behind the lines.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The 'First Battle of Saigon' was fought during the Tet Offensive launched in January 1968. The Vietcong launched 35 battalions at Saigon. The objective was not to take the entire city, which while a major force was not strong enough to take and control the entire city, but concentrated on six main targets in the city.

programme.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
programme.desc: Ranger Combat Training School, Fort Shafter, Territory of Hawaii.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: This episode covers late 1943 and 1944 and shows the preparation for further action after Italy soon joined the allied side due to the defeat of Mussolini. The invasion of France is also discussed.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Defeat and Departure
programme.desc: The final part of the story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including some incredible rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Gustav and Gothic Lines- Battle for Italy
programme.desc: The battle for Anzio as remembered by a German Infantryman and an American Artilleryman.

programme.title: Blitzkrieg: The Lightning War
programme.desc: By the late Summer of 1940 Nazi Germany controlled virtually all of Europe. Beginning in 1936 Germany employed a combination of political intimidation and a series of swift military attacks known as Blitzkrieg to overrun one country after another. Austria, Czechoslovakia, Poland, Norway, Denmark, Holland, Belgium and France all collapse before the onslaught of Hitler's seemingly invincible might.

programme.title: Hidden Side of World War II
programme.desc: This section takes a look behind the scenes at D-Day, revealing confidential decisions taken by the rulers, as well as the involvement of top-ranking officers and secret agents in the operations.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Thanks to the American landing in June 1944, the Allies were certain to end the war before Christmas. This optimism led them to make strategic mistakes, and sometimes to retreat in the face of the Wehrmacht's fierce resistance. When winter came, the enemy may have been weakened, it was far from being dead.
programme.sub-title: Hitler's Last Year - Part I: The Last Blitzkrieg

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Ciudad Juárez, Pati joins in with a group of Pachuco dancers, who are passionately preserving this distinctive Prohibition-era culture's traditions. Together they head to the iconic Kentucky Bar, rumored to be the birthplace of the margarita. Later, she savors an icon of Juárez's food scene, the burrito, at Burritos El Compa where the Olivares are keeping their family legacy alive.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: For the indigenous Rarámuri people, long-distance running through Chihuahua's majestic Copper Canyon is a way of life. Pati meets the Moreno brothers, who are famous for winning ultramarathons. In Huetosachi, community leader María Monarca teaches Pati about the art of cooking with corn in Rarámuri cuisine, from nixtamalization to a traditional dish known as "chacales."

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Chihuahua's capital, Chihuahua City, Pati meets the first member of the Rarámuri people to become a world-famous pianist, Romeyno Gutiérrez, who teaches her the basics of Rarámuri music before taking her to his favorite barbacoa spot. Pati's also invited into the home of Chef Ana Rosa Beltrán del Río to cook a few ancient Chihuahuan recipes and learn the art of drying chiles.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Symphony of Flavors

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati journeys to Casas Grandes to experience the preserved foods, or "conservas," that sustained people during the Mexican Revolution. She meets a family that has lived for generations at Hacienda de San Diego, Mexico's "White House" for a day after the battle of Casas Grandes, including Diana Acosta and her mother, Sara Ramírez, who still preserves food the way they did during the war.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati saddles up for an exhilarating ride into the heart of Chihuahua's ranch and rodeo life. She gets a lesson in roping and riding from rodeo champion Ricardo "Bubba" Nevárez and his friends, then is invited to a post practice carne asada. She also meets Chihuahua's most influential cattle rancher, Álvaro Bustillos, at his Rancho El Arroyo, where the ranch cook serves up some cowboy delicacies.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Casas Grandes, Pati rides in style with local art curator Mayte Luján in her 1960s Cadillac. Mayte owns a bed and breakfast, Las Guacamayas, where she invites Pati into the kitchen to make chile con queso in impossibly soft flour tortillas. Later, Pati learns about another tasty export from Chihuahua, pecans, at Gustavo Vázquez's farm, where his family has been growing them for generations.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Mata Ortiz, a village known for its exquisite pottery, and learns its history from local potter Tavo Silveira, who is known worldwide and even made a piece for the pope. Then Pati gets her hands dirty with talented duo Laura Bugarini and Héctor Gallegos, who teach her the basics of Mata Ortiz pottery. Turns out, Tavo can also cook and makes an asado de puerco feast in the town square.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Mata Ortiz

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the culture of mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany. Mostly, she's after what they're best known for around Mexico, their cheese! She sees their traditional cheese-making process at Pampas Cheese Factory, the holder of the Guinness World Record for largest Mennonite cheese. Then she tries another local culinary innovation, Mennonite pizza.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In one of Chihuahua's most remote areas, Guachochi, Pati shares a traditional Rarámuri meal with community leaders Alejandro Hernández and Margarita González, who advocate for land rights, political representation, and cultural preservation. At Kokoyome, a sustainable ranch in the Sinforosa Canyon, she learns about organic farming practices in the region.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. They begin at the local market to source ingredients. Then Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking and isn't shy to correct him. The final product is a meal that captures Yucatán's history in every bite.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Family Affair

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients only found in Yucatán that make recados unique, touring citrus, habanero, and chaya fields at an hacienda. Then traditional cook Rosa makes a Relleno Negro using recado negro.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A cooperative of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual involving buñuelos made with Melipona honey. Then she visits a family living by the traditional "Solar Maya," meaning they grow everything they eat.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Nectar of the Mayan Gods

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's "league of their own." She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen. After teaching Pati the ins and outs of the game, Doña Enedina invites her over for Brazo de Reina, a tamal with hardboiled eggs and ground pepitas.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Mayan League of their Own

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The 'green' city of Germany has an incredible gothic cathedral with a food market at its feet. Every morning, six days a week, farmers from the Black Forest bring their trout and herb pestoes, wild berries, and smoked ham to the city. Be it a vegan wurst or a tasty cheesecake, here the surprises never finish!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Freiburg

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: An enchanting city, Barcelona is brimming with inspirations left by the greatest of artists. But this charming city has another jewel in its crown - La Boqueria food market. Take a journey through the senses with our lively characters and uncover their gastronomic secrets.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Barcelona

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits Laconia, where the famous Kalamata olive is cultivated, to follow the famous olive from harvest to table. After a chilly day of collecting, scoring, and processing the ripened fruits, Diane heads to the kitchen to whip up an olive feast. Find out how olives can transform any meal into a masterpiece.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The World's Most Famous Olive

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane travels to her family's native island of Ikaria, where locals are 10 times more likely to live to one hundred than Americans. Diane's young 85-year-old neighbors share a lesson in making wild herb teas; a beekeeper reveals the honey that is one of the secrets to Ikarians' renowned longevity. Enjoy the deliciously simple and wonderfully healthy cuisine of Ikaria.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors of Longevity - Ikaria

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the ancient grains that Greek cooks still love to use. Learn how to incorporate timeless ancient grains into every meal of the day.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Ancient Grains for Modern Cooks

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Emerald green Greek extra virgin olive oil is the star of this show. Diane takes us on a journey to the stunningly preserved town of Monemvasia. Explore the diversity and beauty of one of Greece's most delectable exports.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Olive Oil Everything

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the meze tradition of small plates of vibrant food meant to be shared. She uncovers the vast variety and robust flavors of the meze table and invites a wine expert into the kitchen for advice on what to pair when the meal includes spice, yogurt, cheese, crunch, comfort, seafood, meat and more, all in one sitting. Discover the fun and festive meze tradition.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Meze Society

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Go on a picnic at a vineyard in Naoussa were one grape dominates the table: the local Xinomavro, one of Greece's noblest reds. On the wine trail, Diane discovers bread, cookies and chocolate truffles all spiked with this hard-to-pronounce but easy-to-love Greek varietal. Learn how to incorporate incomparable Greek wine into any menu, both as a drink and an ingredient.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Bite of Greek Red Wine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane celebrates the intensely flavored food and unique wines of one of Greece's most breathtaking islands, Santorini. Diane hops in a boat to pick capers on this volcanic island. She visits a renowned vineyard which still practices the island tradition of growing grapes in basket-shaped vines. Enjoy the tastes of Santorini with ingredients from field to sea.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors Of A Volcano

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Kitchen Techniques

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don't have to spend a fortune if you chose what's in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you're in a hurry, it's okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Vegetables Every Way

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home

But when Dee-Dee (Alicia Silverstone), the girl who was his adolescent obsession, returns home a single mother after being gone for years, Sam struggles as his old feelings return. Dee-Dee opens a candle-making workshop, and Sam and Lydia cautiously befriend her young son, Trooper (Matthew Knight) -- wondering about Dee-Dee's intentions all the while.

programme.title: The Seventh Stream
programme.desc: Five years after the death of his wife, Owen Quinn (Scott Glenn), a turn-of-the-century Irish fisherman, is still in a deep state of grief. One day, in accordance with Irish folklore, a seal emerges from the water and transforms into a gorgeous woman named Mairead (Saffron Burrows). Owen and Mairead meet and quickly begin to fall in love. However, the two realize their relationship might be short-lived, because, also according to legend, Mairead must soon return to the ocean and live as a seal.

Vance) and schizophrenic Barry (Robert Sean Leonard). When Jack announces his decision to leave his job, his four charges react quite unexpectedly to the news.

His services are rendered by the Imperial treasury, who wants him to infiltrate a powerful gang of Highwaymen and get back the stolen silver bullion. After numerous deadly encounters the gang is beaten by the bamboo sword and only the gang leader remains; however he's a lot tougher than they originally bargained for.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Itto received an assassination request to kill a feudal lord and was betrayed by a traitor in the clan. Daigoro was ambushed and the two of them got separated. In their times apart from each other they learn more about family bonds and what it means to become a parent.
programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 9

programme.title: The Shaolin Kids
programme.desc: When a ruthless Premier Hu Wei Yung, writes a self-incriminating letter that ends up in the wrong hands (the delicate but deadly hands of the lovely Su Lin), he will stop at nothing to get it back. Premier kidnaps Miss Lin's father and she risks everything to free him.

programme.title: Shaolin Red Master
programme.desc: Left at the Shaolin Temple after the murder of his parents, the kid learns well the fighting skills of the monks. At the peak of his study, he learns about the circumstances of his parents death and goes to seek the identity of the killer.

programme.title: Duel of Karate
programme.desc: Twin baby boys are separated at birth when their kung fu master father and mother are slaughtered by an opposing kung fu clan. The two live separate lives, but fate later throws them into a duel to the death with each other. A master class in kung fu cinema highly recommended. Wall to wall action.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: How will Tako, Lord, Sengoku, and Okei chan deal with inspectors who ban extravagance and enforce a simple life on everyone?
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 6

programme.title: Chinese Dragon
programme.desc: Barry Chan, upon release from prison for killing a man, has to decide whether to help his father stand up to local crime gangs who are trying to force him out of his home. If he stays and fights, he risks returning to jail.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 2 - Way of Challenge
programme.desc: Sword of Catastrophe is stolen by the Black Ninja, who seeks to free the sword's energy and become all-powerful. Only Ninja Gordon can prevent this catastrophe, but in his search for the secret he comes across an unlikely crew of ninja misfits, who teach him the way to defeat the Black Ninja's dark skills.

programme.title: Fury in Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: Pak Si-baek, master of the Taekwondo martial arts, and Wang Pa-san, master of the Jeong-mu Taekwondo martial arts, decide to take each other's child and teach them their martial arts styles. But when Si-baek arrives at the Shaolin Buddhist Temple, the Buddhist priest Gong-young of the school of Jeong-Mu has already been kicked out. Si-baek is accused of playing a part in stealing the Shaolin secret manuscripts and imprisoned according to Jeong-mu law. The school of Jeong-mu flourishes.

programme.title: The Magnificent Duo
programme.desc: Leopard, seeks to dominate the opium market. Who can stop him? The Magnificent Duo is ready and willing to take on the gangsters and their Japanese ninja allies in their righteous fight to stand up for the poor and challenge the wicked.

programme.title: Warriors of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two brothers rendered blind and dumb by Chang must learn crippled kung fu, and with the help of a vengeful warrior lady set out to take on the gang and their villainous leader. Two sons of the head of gangsters and an expertise Kung Fu master, comes to Canton and kills Yu-Sing. In this incident, Yu's one son, Yu-Yung loses his eye-sight and his brother, Yu-Ho becomes dumb. They have to be trained in special cripple-Kung Fu. The two sons leave Canton to Fuchow to take revenge on the gangsters.

programme.title: Mystery of Chess Boxing
programme.desc: Lee Yi Min stars as a young boy, Ah Pao, who wants to learn kung fu so that he can avenge his father's death at the hands of the Ghost Faced Killer (Mark Long). The Ghost Faced Killer, meanwhile is hunting down a number of clan leaders who all conspired to have him killed. Before attacking, the killer always throws down his "ghost face killing plate," a decorated metal plate with a red face. He then uses his distinctive five elements style.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Eric Lee
programme.desc: Eric Lee is considered the pioneer of Chinese Kung Fu in the American Karate Tournament Circuit. Stepping into the area that was filled with all white gi's, Lee was the only Chinese Kung Fu competitor. Through his innovative style and expert Kung Fu ability, he quickly became the greatest competitors in the forms and weapons division. He was so impressive he was nicknamed "The King of Kata.

programme.title: Thunder Prince
programme.desc: When Blue Thunder, a wise man who owns the secret of Carne Technique, is slaughtered by three greedy villains, his son swears revenge and goes to the forest to get the martial arts training he needs to defeat his enemies. But his journey is not easy, as he thought when Master Soul tries to teach him that the true power of the martial arts is a lot more than taking revenge. With Thunder Mantis on their trail they must find ways to use the jungle to their advantage.

programme.title: Snake in the Eagle's Shadow Pt 2
programme.desc: Ah Fu (Wang Tao) and Chen Ting Kuan (Carter Wong) are a couple of kung fu men in the escort service business with top notch kung fu styles. Ah Fu gets tired of the escort service and quits and takes up the life of a normal man. In his new "life", Ah Fu runs into a thief named Li Chi (Li Kun), and the two become the best of friends. Life is great! Ah Fu gets married to a pretty girl, Yu Lan (Ha Ling Ling). He has money, servants, and foot massages. What else could you want?

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon
programme.desc: After a valuable antique is stolen; two sons (Dragon Lee and Carter Wong) swear to avenge their father's death and search of the last man to see him alive, but they are caught in a mystery of betrayal and murder. The brothers use their heads as well as their fists to find out why their father had to die.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai
programme.desc: Under the strict rule of the new Shogun, many samurais were suddenly outcast and became Ronins. A group of rogue Ronins kept an inn under hostage in a plot to overthrow the current shogunate.

programme.title: Image Of Bruce Lee Aka Storming Attacks
programme.desc: A band of counterfeiters wants to make Hong Kong their new territory. The disgraced leader of the Special Squad will have to team-up with a group of Hong Kong police officers in an attempt to stop the dirty business of crime lord Han Tin Lung, but Han's problem not only is the interference of the Police force, his Japanese ally Kimura is not happy with his 'cut' in the counterfeit deal and will try to put Donna (a relative of Han) on his side and make Han's business his own property.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim negocia con Aurelio para impedir el paso del uranio. Leonor queda fuera del caso Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se enfrenta al Tijeras para cobrarle el asesinato de Chacorta, mientras se salva de la muerte a manos de aliados de Marcado. Julia busca a Leonor para que ayude a Tim.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim y Rivero atacan al Chema, mientras Marcado y Medardo asaltan el búnker para matar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas mata a Medardo, y Marcado huye para ayudar al Chema luego de que Tim y Rivero incautan el uranio. Tijeras también escapa, mientras Mónica acepta la condición de Omar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La tormentosa relación de Mónica y Aurelio se quiebra: él le confiesa que sus hombres mataron accidentalmente a Ximena, y que nunca dejó de amarla. Victoria ordena allanar el rancho de Danilo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria se horroriza cuando descubre que Danilo Ferro es en realidad Aurelio Casillas. Chacorta alerta a su hermano de abandonar el funeral de Ximena, porque los de la Marina vienen por ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a su padre, le dice que se acostó con su peor enemigo y le da pistas de dónde está. Ahora los Casillas quieren acabar con el Chema, pero solo logran atraer a la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria le tiende una trampa a Aurelio, pero es ella quien paga las consecuencias por traicionarlo. Leonor se enfrenta al Señor de los Cielos, y luego de tantos años, al fin logra capturarlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aislado en una celda, Aurelio es torturado y envenenado. Despierta de su letargo cuando recibe la prueba del asesinato de Chacorta. Negocia su libertad para vengar la muerte de su hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio acepta su traslado a cambio de ver a su familia. Rutila lo rechaza, pero le presenta al hijo de Mónica; mientras doña Alba viaja a Sinaloa. Leonor y Casillas son emboscados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y Leonor suben al tren "La Bestia" para huir de dos grupos que buscan atraparlos. Rivero pide refuerzos para enfrentar a los rebeldes, comandados por Marcado y Medardo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y Leonor resisten el asedio de los militares y de las maras. El Chema acusa al Tijeras del asesinato de Chacorta, mientras negocia el contrabando de uranio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor sucumbe ante Aurelio antes de ser rescatados por Rivero y Tim. El iraní recibe el uranio, mientras Tim sorprende a Leonor con un cambio de planes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim negocia con Aurelio para impedir el paso del uranio. Leonor queda fuera del caso Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se enfrenta al Tijeras para cobrarle el asesinato de Chacorta, mientras se salva de la muerte a manos de aliados de Marcado. Julia busca a Leonor para que ayude a Tim.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim y Rivero atacan al Chema, mientras Marcado y Medardo asaltan el búnker para matar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas mata a Medardo, y Marcado huye para ayudar al Chema luego de que Tim y Rivero incautan el uranio. Tijeras también escapa, mientras Mónica acepta la condición de Omar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor golpea a Casillas, lo deja herido y amenaza con matarlo: ahora sabe que sexo y muerte van de la mano. Mónica y Rutila ya tienen su propio negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas busca a Mónica, pero ella lo rechaza y le dice que se aleje de su hijo, mientras el Chema amenaza a Rutila. Tijeras convence a Marcado y se escapan a Colombia en un avión del Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas sorprende a su familia, pero Irma lo acusa de haber entregado a Chacorta a cambio de su libertad. Rutila recibe la carta de Ernesto, mientras el Chema le exige que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim le pide a Casillas que le envíe un cargamento de droga a Chicago, pero él no tiene ni mercancía ni dinero para volver a montar su red de narcotráfico. Leonor ve de nuevo a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas jura ante la tumba de Chacorta que vengará su muerte, y acusa a Irma de ser la culpable por convencerlo de dejar el negocio. Prepara una coartada para llevar a cabo su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio mata a Irma, y hace ver que murió en el ataque de la Policía y la Marina al rancho de Sinaloa. Logran escapar del tiroteo, pero Chabela queda malherida. Feyo promete enviar la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor llora la muerte de Chabela y de sus hijos, mientras Casillas le plantea la venganza. Tim trata de convencer a Rivero de que Aurelio no estaba en Sinaloa. Leonor busca olvidar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor le dice a Aurelio que acepta entrar en el negocio para vengar la muerte de Chabela y sus hijos, y le entrega el dinero de la venta del ganado. Mónica le exige al Chema que se aleje.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta seducir a la Condesa, quien le coquetea, pero asegura que es fiel a Feyo. Víctor quiere comenzar su venganza y matar al que dio el pitazo de que estaba en el rancho de Sinaloa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor viaja con Aurelio a Chicago para entregar la droga a Tim, y crecen sus sospechas sobre el Espanto. Rutila visita a Ernesto y le miente, mientras doña Alba la compara con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema secuestra a su propio hijo para demostrarle a Rutila que él pone las reglas, mientras su rabia aumenta luego de que el Güero le dice que le hizo una visita conyugal a Ernesto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema sigue castigando a Rutila: le dice que tiene que ganarse a su hijo o la madre sustituta lo hará. Garnica recibe el dinero para matar a Ernesto, ahora con el apoyo de Venegas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le propone a Feyo una alianza: comprar su finca, pero que, a cambio, lo ayude a matar al Chema. Leonor acusa a Rawlins de utilizar a Aurelio para inundar a Chicago de drogas y llevarse los elogios.

programme.sub-title: La hija del difunto; Peligro en la carretera

programme.sub-title: Violado por alma gemela; El rapero sin rap

programme.sub-title: Drag queen abusado; Gota a gota

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfredo descubre que varios hombres lo vigilan y su esposa está detrás de todo. El padre de Lisbeth se quita la vida después de que Carlos, un cazador de pedófilos, lo pilla y graba un video.
programme.sub-title: Perseguido por el pasado; Persiguiendo la verdad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés no soporta el cambio de su mujer a una vida más saludable y le pide el divorcio. Rubén descubre que su pareja, Pavel, le es infiel y busca compensación por los daños que le ha causado.
programme.sub-title: La gorda fitness; No se hagan los suecos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandro cree que maltrataron a su cuñado en el restaurante de Claudia, donde el chico trabaja, y la demanda. Sonia quiere que Juan José le devuelva su anillo, pero la prenda fue subastada.
programme.sub-title: Discriminación a la vista; Solo cenizas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana culpa al esposo de Claudia de profanar el cadáver de su marido para falsificar su identidad, pide compensación. Roxana está embarazada y su novio cree que un hijo contamina el planeta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por celos, el hijo de la pareja de Claudia mete al nuevo bebé de la familia en el horno. Ricardo y Alejandro están casados, pero difieren sobre la yegua Jénica y se pelean su custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yudy es una bailarina erótica que está cansada de mantener a su esposo, quien trajo a su novia a vivir en la casa. Rafael quiere dejar a su amante por violar las reglas acordadas y embarazarse.
programme.sub-title: Tres strippers y un chulo; Manutención de barriga

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jimmy adopta al bebé concebido cuando era heterosexual, pide el divorcio y división de bienes. Maritza le exige 30 mil dólares a Ángel por difamarla en las redes para aumentar su popularidad.
programme.sub-title: Refugio seguro; Falso crimen de odio

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roberto no ha logrado superar un trauma de la niñez y por eso afecta la tranquilidad de sus hijos al sobreprotegerlos. El amigo de una tatuadora profesional la mete en problemas con un cártel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: David le exige a sus empleadas atender a los clientes en ropa interior, ellas lo acusan de acoso sexual. Dos dúos que formaron un cuarteto se enfrentan por dinero y por el nombre artístico.
programme.sub-title: Tanga protesta; Los cuatro a la mitad

programme.desc: Susana está obsesionada con casarse con un violador y busca uno en la cárcel, pero él se regeneró. José compra un perro para ayudar a su hija deprimida, ahora Gabriela dice que es la dueña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: El brete de Alexa; El peligro del carbón

programme.sub-title: Sueño vs. droga; Falsa menor de edad

programme.sub-title: Adicto a mi madre; Fanático sin sentido

programme.desc: Karla usa una aplicación de teléfono para sus compras y se hizo amiga del mensajero, su esposo la acusa de tener sexo oral con él. Un psicólogo trata a sus pacientes con un método peculiar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanesa se casa con Eduardo y comete el error de poner todo su dinero a nombre de él. También, Alejandro quiere recibir terapia de pareja con su esposa Carla para así salvar su matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carina sufre una extraña enfermedad y su hermano Rasiel pide su custodia. Cuando su hermanito muere, los padres le regalan un perro, pero ahora el niño cree que el animal es el difunto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María y Carlos tenían cuatro años de relación y en Navidad se descubre la infidelidad de uno de ellos. Carlos usa la violencia con los que no comparten su filosofía de vida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lupe quiere desalojar a su hija Diana y a su yerno Ángel, porque él antes era mujer. Los mariachis van a dar una serenata y el trompetista se sorprende al descubrir la infidelidad de su esposa.
programme.sub-title: Mujer macho: Seguimiento; Ya mi trompeta no suena

programme.desc: Su hijo padece una discapacidad mental que provoca problemas de comportamiento, llamada X frágil, la madre lo sobreprotege. Por publicidad, encierran a un niño vestido de mexicano en una jaula.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Preñada en coma; El enredo de las maletas

programme.desc: No longer just the stuff of legend, flying monsters are raining down terror from above. These airborne attacks have sparked fear across communities. Witnesses tell of their harrowing encounters with a Flying Humanoid, Batsquatch, and the Jersey Devil.

programme.desc: Join us on a chilling investigation as we unravel the spectral enigmas within Clarke Zoo Gardens. Eerie encounters and eerie secrets await.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Dive into the unexplained as we explore a barn filled with uncharted spirits, whispers from the other side, and chilling encounters.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: In 1995, a small UK village was disrupted by a brutal fire that destroyed its town hall. To this day, no culprit has emerged - were otherworldly forces responsible?

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: For decades, Kent's Blue Bell Hill has been the site of mysterious phenomena. Rumored ghost sightings have haunted the pastoral site. Explore the haunting legacy of Blue Bell Hill in this episode.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted be previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Labyrinth Lodge in Liverpool in the UK is a haunted house in a cemetery. Originally it was a register office, recording births, deaths and marriages. But it seems some previous residents just don't want to leave. Paranormal investigator Jayne Harris is on hand to capture proof for current owners Sean and Bex, who are hoping to understand more about the strange goings on in their home.

programme.title: War On Witches
programme.desc: In the late 16th century Europe was in the grip of a witch hunt fever. Thousands were tortured and burnt at the stake. The church was fully behind this terrifying crusade. In France and Germany alone up to 40,000 people may have been killed as witches. England and Scotland were almost untouched by witch persecutions until King James himself decided to launch his own, personal war on witchcraft.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Is this remarkable piece of linen the actual burial cloth of Jesus Christ or a clever medieval con? Richard talks to top Shroud investigators who give the latest scientific evidence they claim proves the cloth is not only genuine, but holds evidence of a real resurrection event.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: For years, farmers have been discovering strange geometric patterns comprised of rings, circles and other complex shapes in their fields. Are they calling cards from extraterrestrials? Are they manmade hoaxes? Do they have some religious significance? Richard investigates with the top crop circle researchers in an effort to solve this centuries old mystery.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Fluoride, The Conspiracy Show investigates the safety and efficacy of putting fluoride in our water supply. Dentists say that putting fluoride in the water supply prevents tooth decay, but some researchers claim it's a toxic substance that causes cancer. Others claim it is being used to pacify and dumb down the general population. Who to believe? Tune in and decide for yourself.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Mississippi to interview an expedition organizer who plans to lead a team to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world. A researcher and member of the planned expedition provides evidence that the earth, like all planets, was formed with a hollow core.
programme.sub-title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to London to investigate various theories revolving around the tragic death of Diana, The former Princess of Wales. Was the fatal car crash in a Paris tunnel in August 1997 a result of a drunken driver or was she murdered? Was she pregnant with the child of Dodi Al Fayed? Was she perceived as a threat to the Royal Family?
programme.sub-title: The Death of Princess Diana: Tragic Car Accident or Murder Most Foul?

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time man has expressed his religious beliefs through rock art, it gives the feeling that he has worshipped some mysterious gods, that generally came from the stars. Over the millennia, these gods have changed in shape and name, but the way they have been disguised in our beliefs remains the same, in many cases to the misfortune of the witnesses.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From Mafasca, in the plains of Fuerteventura, to Pardal, in the mountains of Albacete, passing through the light of Cayón in Cantabria, we are talking about intelligent luminosities. These are seen at night and have even followed witnesses. They are the most commonly seen lights, undoubtedly a phenomenon that is part of another of the strangest aspects of the UFO theme: The foo- fighters.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The sun. It's an immense powerhouse on a scale that almost defies the imagination. And it's the source of all life here on Earth. But what if that power was being tampered with? Are UFOs really visiting our Sun?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Each year, there are thousands of UFO sightings all over the world. What are these different kind of UFOs? What is each craft's purpose? What powers them and how they are controlled? And most importantly- who is flying them?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For over sixty years authorities the world over have been inundated with highly credible reports of UFOs. But according to experts, many governments have gone to great lengths to cover-up the truth about extraterrestrial life.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The Great Deceiver. Seducer of the masses. The Bringer of Armageddon. Every culture and religion on the planet believes that an evil one will usher in the end of days. But who is this Anti-Christ? And how can we hope to stop him?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: We rely on machines for virtually every aspect of modern life. Have we reached the point where we need them more than they need us? If technology goes too far, too fast, there may be a time where we are no longer at the top of the evolutionary food chain.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.
